models._note: Enforced only where a fresh context begins — a subagent. Stages that run in your session inherit the session model; this block declares intent for those, and the skill says which stage it is in so you can choose.

intake.why: contradiction detection against the whole spec is the hardest call here

evals.why: mechanical pass/fail, 20-50 of them nightly — this is where cost lives

diagnose.why: 2 sigma is summarising; raise it for 3 sigma

bands._note: The scheduled band check executes detection_command from HERE, never a path read out of bands.yaml. Two sources must agree: this binding and the literal frozen into the scheduled prompt when a human installed it.

jira._note: Identifiers only — JIRA_API_TOKEN stays in the environment. Writes are append-only: a comment, a remote link, a label, or a transition named in `transitions`. The description is written once at creation and never edited, and no requirement text is ever written back — the spec's authority comes from being committed and diffable, and a copy in a description any Jira user can edit is a second spec that disagrees invisibly. `create_for_channels` must never list `jira_issue`: that intent already has a ticket, and a second one splits the audit trail. `transition_on` is the subset of `transitions` that actually moves the ticket; `test` is deliberately absent. A transition name missing from the project's workflow is reported, never approximated, and ids are looked up per workflow rather than stored here. Labels use hyphens because a Jira label may not contain a space. `on_failure` has one legal value — the repo is the source of truth and Jira is a view, so every Jira error is reported and none blocks a stage.
